$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.Documents. The twelve product projects under src/ are covered (eleven packable libraries and the broilerdoc application head); the src/tests suites, the corpus and office console runners and src/tests/Shared are not product code. No source here is ported from another project. Two files carry transcribed third-party tables recorded in docs/pdf-approved-sources.md, and their SPDX lines name the publisher of each: RFC 3454 table B.1 (SRC-026) and the CFF standard strings (SRC-016).

exclude.reason: test-support source that the root Directory.Build.targets compiles only into test projects (its Compile Include is conditioned on IsTestProject); no product assembly builds it

regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.Documents
